newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds rallied to close higher on Friday after U.S. job figures gave the market the impetus it had been waiting for.

After a quiet morning during which many players were sidelined, ignoring a lower than expected Dutch January CPI figure and looking ahead to the release of the U.S. data, trade became more brisk in the afternoon.
"There was some good demand, especially in the longer end," one dealer said.
Jan 2023s ended 78 basis points higher at 115.35/55, yielding 6.28 percent at bid.
